materialReview.observation: Native inherited emission and purple effects brighten the authored ivory/obsidian palette in the live view; this is recorded as a material/readability limitation, not silently treated as the studio color.

progression: Two native Collect actions were accepted and strict native Ready was observed at level 0 room 2.

selectedPNGs.observation: Idle combat view: the upper cranium, horns, glowing eye sockets, separate jaw and teeth form a coherent floating skull; native purple emission/effects strongly tint the palette.
Second idle view: the jaw remains seated under the cranium and the eye sockets, horns and teeth stay readable despite native glow.
Ordinary attack setup: both skull parts remain aligned while native purple effects and target rings appear.
Attack selection view: the skull silhouette and independent jaw remain intact, while native targeting and green hero effects occlude lower-frame detail.
Explicit KillSingle fixture begins with the native attack-choice surface; the bound multipart skull remains visible.
Native victory/item-choice endpoint after the fixture kill; no visible corpse deformation or floor-contact claim is made.

limits: Selected frames establish multipart binding, readable skull/jaw attachment and scoped motion in the fresh combat path. Inherited emission and native purple effects change live color/readability; UI/effects and the victory surface limit complete jaw/death deformation, culling-envelope, portrait/resource lifetime and finished-art acceptance.
